description:
Finds the times a user can book at a place. Start here for any booking: only the place is required.
The answer lists, per date, windows of bookable starts. To book, pick a start from a window's from up to and
including its lastStart, a whole number of stepMinutes after from (no stepMinutes means any minute), then send
that start, the answer's durationMinutes and one of the window's streamIds to create_booking.
The earliest time is the first window's from.
Windows hold for one booking length, the answer's durationMinutes: set it with serviceIds or durationMinutes,
otherwise it is the place's shortest booking. For another length, search again rather than stretching a window.
Arguments use the place's local clock; answers are UTC.
The answer is advisory: create_booking checks again and names the nearest bookable starts when it refuses.
Staff booking for a customer at their own place set forCustomer, so the answer matches the create_booking
they will send: the place's minimum notice does not apply to it.

date.description: First date to search, yyyy-MM-dd in the place's time zone; defaults to today there, and a past date is moved up to it. The last date searched may be at most 6 months ahead.

days.description: How many dates to search from date onwards, 1 to 7; defaults to one when you name a date and 3 when you do not.

durationMinutes.description: Booking length in minutes when no service carries one; the place's shortest length by default, capped at its longest.

forCustomer.description: Staff only: true when the booking will be made for a customer with create_booking's customer arguments. Refused with BOOKING_NOT_ALLOWED unless the caller works at the place.

geoHash.description: geoHash of the place, as search_places, get_place and list_my_places return it.

partySize.description: Capacity wanted, e.g. the number of people; defaults to 1.

serviceIds.description: Services from get_place_services; their combined length is then the booking's length.

timeFrom.description: Earliest start wanted, local 24-hour time like 14:00; omit for the whole day.

timeTo.description: Latest start wanted, local 24-hour time like 18:00, not before timeFrom; omit for the whole day.

name: find_booking_times

autoConfirm.description: True when a booking holds the time at once; false means create_booking answers PENDING and the place confirms.

days.description: One entry per date searched, in order.

date.description: Date, yyyy-MM-dd in the place's time zone.

status.description: available, partial, fully_booked, closed, unavailable or exceeds_limits.

tooSoon.description: True when the place is open that day but every start is earlier than minStartsAt: too soon, not closed.

windows.description: The day's bookable windows, earliest first; absent when the place offers none.

from.description: Earliest bookable start, ISO-8601 UTC; pass it to create_booking as startsAt.

lastStart.description: Latest bookable start in this window, ISO-8601 UTC; itself bookable.

localFrom.description: Start on the place's clock, HH:mm.

localLastStart.description: Latest start on the place's clock, HH:mm.

streamIds.description: Streams free for this whole window; book any one of them, the first by default.

to.description: When a booking starting at lastStart ends, ISO-8601 UTC. A booking must fit inside one window.

windowsTruncated.description: True when the day held more windows than fit the answer; narrow timeFrom and timeTo to see the rest.

durationMinutes.description: Length these times are for, in minutes: the services' combined length, or the length asked for, capped at the place's maximum.

geoHash.description: GeoHash of that place, its other half of the key.

maxDurationMinutes.description: Longest booking this place allows, in minutes; present with requiredDurationMinutes.

minStartsAt.description: Earliest start this place accepts from now, ISO-8601 UTC.

notes.description: Plain sentences worth passing on to the user, e.g. where the length of these times came from.

placeId.description: Id of the place these times are for; pass it back to create_booking.

placeName.description: Name of that place; say it to the user when several places are in play.

requiredDurationMinutes.description: Minutes the chosen services need; present only when that is more than one booking may last.

searchedFrom.description: First date searched, yyyy-MM-dd; a past date is moved up to today at the place.

searchedTo.description: Last date searched, yyyy-MM-dd; search later days by asking again from the day after it.

slotMode.description: FIXED_STEP means starts fall on the stepMinutes grid; FLEXIBLE means any minute inside a window.

stepMinutes.description: Grid step between the starts inside a window, in minutes; absent when the place books at any minute.

streams.description: Every stream mentioned below, with its name: the streamIds in windows are bare.

streamId.description: Stream id: a bookable resource such as a table, a chair or a specialist.

timezone.description: IANA time zone of the place; every local time below is in it.

title: Find bookable times
